items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

ctx.x: Did you get a chance to hear them before the gig? © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

Well at least I got a chance — Bobby Bryant, the trumpet player, a wonderful trumpet player, he was on the gig and he helped me a great deal. I managed to write about six charts and he wrote about three or four more. And when I got hung up writing them — you probably know Gerry Wiggins.
